summary: Healthy 36 y smoker for open inguinal hernia repair. A control case: the issues are smoking (cigarette at 0645), airway reactivity under LMA, and anxiety.

decision.rationale: No contraindication. Clears stopped at 0700 for an 1130 case.

redFlags.finding: Smoked 4.5 h before induction, daily vaping, morning productive cough
redFlags.evidence: Last cigarette 0645 in the parking lot; 19 pack years.
redFlags.implication: Carboxyhemoglobin (pulse oximetry overestimates), airway irritability, laryngospasm and bronchospasm with LMA.
redFlags.action: Adequate depth before airway manipulation, bronchodilator available, smoking cessation counseling.

planItems.item: LMA general anesthetic or MAC with local
Cefazolin 2 g within 60 min of incision
